data.gender_notes: Rutvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rutvi means one who brings joy and laughter. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rut' which means joy and 'Vi' which means one who brings. Rutvi is a name that represents creativity and is often associated with the Moon. The name Rutvi carries the meaning “Joy, Laughter, Creativity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rutvi usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, laughter, creativity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rutvi is a spiritual name that signifies joy and happiness. It is believed that those named Rutvi are blessed with the ability to bring joy and laughter to others.
